text.aria-label: Title text 'Quantile score of the day-ahead forecast of six metered solar farms (A to F), mean over farms, 12 to 36 h leads, daylight half-hours, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Own history: the plant scale is fitted on the farm's own earlier months. Zero history: the scale is the median of the other five farms. Dot: estimate (mean over five seeds for networks). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the day-ahead forecast of six metered solar farms (A to F), mean over farms,
12 to 36 h leads, daylight half-hours, 2025-09 to 2026-08. Own history: the plant scale is fitted on the
farm's own earlier months. Zero history: the scale is the median of the other five farms. Dot: estimate (mean
over five seeds for networks). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.
